images: Byte-identical to screening-rich-12 packages; 204 image inspections, no new rasters.
blinding: Six fresh reviewer contexts; anonymous arm folders only; previous outputs, identities and key withheld. Procedural file-access restriction, not OS sandbox.
concurrency: Two waves, at most three reviewers; separate fresh worker for every arm/group.
limitations: Same repeated overlapping reference-point crops; no new independently verified visible features or negatives. Historical low run is a one-shot comparison, not a randomized replicated effort experiment.
